scope: Read-only baseline and plan preparation. No test, listener, worker, Unity, engine, APK, ADB or device operation started.
proposedTcpDrill: Start actual new staging launcher under owned suspended/assigned Windows job with retained127.0.0.1:0 socket and a private rendezvous proof, using a fresh owned database.
Enroll two real P-256 managed guests over actual TCP; independently bind challenge signing bytes and assert exactly one genesis per player.
Create a team, join second player, send member chat and exact retry without duplicate membership/message/wallet effects.
Stop only the owned process, verify listener closed, restart sameDB and read preserved identity/wallet/team/chat state.
Use real SQLite backup API against live WAL; restore only to a different newDB, restart restored DB and recheck integrity plus financial/social state.
Close exact owned job/listener and retain failure/source snapshots; no ordinary profiles/database or credential exports.
reuse: Backend/tools/review_operational93.py canonical/P-256 auth/owned-process/backup patterns; its obsolete schema8/full drill is not rerun.
worker: Not proposed unless actual staging readiness requires the existing approved worker; no gameplay/fullbackend expansion by default.
credentialPolicy: Only static labels, counts, timings, source hashes and redacted status codes leave private storage. Request/response bodies, public-key payloads, private keys, access/refresh/recovery data and DBs remain private/inmemory.
nonClaims: No production mode, deployment or capacity certification

approvedContract.restoreTarget: New owned root/restores/<tag>, no in-place overwrite or automatic activation

retryBoundary: For chat, intentionally do not consume a successful response body, terminate the owned service, then retry the exact command after restart; label as controlled client-body discard, not an unobserved network loss.
actualHttpFlow: Actual staging CLI and retained loopback socket; two signed guest enrollments; create/join/chat receipts retried before and after crash-style owned restart and new-root restore; wrapper live-WAL backup; no provider/worker/device.
